title: Turing Agent: Agentic Formal Verification for Mathematical Research
abstract: arXiv:2611.21299v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are rapidly advancing mathematical discovery, moving beyond benchmark-level problem solving to tackle frontier research problems. This progress is ushering mathematics into an era of proof abundance, raising a fundamental challenge: how can we ensure the correctness of the ever-growing volume of AI-generated proofs and transform them into trustworthy, machine-verified mathematical knowledge? We introduce Turing Agent, an agent harness designed to orchestrate end-to-end formal verification of research-level mathematics. Its wo-scale architecture integrates theorem formalization and proof formalization agents, empowered by structured proof decomposition, parallel verification, accumulated proof experience, and selective semantic review. translated_title: 图灵智能体：面向数学研究的智能体形式化验证
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）正在快速推进数学发现，其能力已超越基准测试级别的问题求解，开始攻克前沿研究问题。这一进展正引领数学进入一个“证明丰裕”的时代，同时也带来一个根本性挑战：如何确保不断增长的AI生成证明的正确性，并将其转化为可信的、经机器验证的数学知识？我们提出了图灵智能体，这是一个旨在对研究级数学进行端到端形式化验证编排的智能体框架。其双层架构集成了定理形式化智能体与证明形式化智能体，并通过结构化证明分解、并行验证、证明经验积累以及选择性语义审查加以增强。借助与理论计算机科学（TCS）研究者的合作，我们将评估重点放在TCS这一要求极高的领域上，该领域以复杂的量词结构为特征。
tldr: 该论文提出“图灵智能体”，一个对研究级数学进行端到端形式化验证的智能体框架，通过集成定理形式化与证明形式化智能体的双层架构，结合结构化证明分解、并行验证、证明经验积累和选择性语义审查，确保AI生成的数学证明可信可靠。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Turing Agent, an agentic framework that orchestrates end-to-end formal verification of research-level mathematics, leveraging a two-tier architecture integrating theorem and proof formalization agents with structured proof decomposition, parallel verification, accumulated proof experience, and selective semantic review.
